_doc: Narrative vocabulary for the client-side chronicler (game/ui/chronicle-narrate.js). PURE DATA — the composer interprets this to turn the sim's terse per-entity event log into a flowing tale (time connectives, recurrence callbacks, an opening frame + closing coda). No prose is hardcoded in JS. Presentation only; never read by the sim. Tone: restrained ship's-chronicle. {token} substitution; unknown/empty tokens collapse with adjacent glue. {ord} is an ordinal WORD (ordinals[n], else an Nth suffix).

phrases: Her crew crossed the line and raised the black flag; she was a merchant no more.
So she was lost to the black flag — no longer an honest trader, but a predator of the lanes.
Run down at last and boarded, she was hauled back into honest service.
The black flag came down: taken by a hunter, she was restored to lawful trade.
— not the first she had taken
, the {ord} port she had put to the torch
— she had shaken off wolves before
, not the first time her discipline had cracked
— the streets had risen here before
— the {ord} ruler cast down on these wharves

ship: — the same raider that had taken the {foeName}
, the {ord} {foeHome} hull to strike to her

status.privateer: — a hunter under letters of marque

ship.pirate: To this day {name} roves the lanes{bounty}.
ship.default: {name} runs her cargoes still, out of {home}.

island.haven: {name} flies the black flag yet — a den of cutthroats.

quiet.ship: Her log holds little of note — a quiet life on the trade lanes.
quiet.island: The port's chronicle is calm — trade comes and goes, and little else is written.
